qa: direct: How does one signature power or defining concept of a widely recognized hero work? Pick one source-supported mechanism or limit from an issue excerpt and ask only about that.

direct: Why did a widely recognized hero adopt or change a defining power, identity, or belief? Pick one source-supported motive or change stated in an issue excerpt; if the motive is absent, ask what changed instead.
direct: What is one defining rule or feature of a comic world tied to a widely recognized hero or team? Ask about one source-supported premise or rule, without adding consequences or stakes.
direct: How does a widely recognized hero apply one defining rule or recurring choice? Ask about one source-supported condition or reason; ask why only when the issue excerpt states the motive.
